games:2026-wk12-ucla-michigan.blurb: No. 4 UCLA heads to Ann Arbor as just a 3.5-point favorite with a 37.5 total, and ESPN's model sees it as close to a coin flip at 52.9%. The Bruins are the Big Ten's current leader, so a slip in a low-scoring slugfest would reshuffle the league's automatic bid.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-utah-tcu.blurb: No. 2 Utah visits TCU laying seven, with ESPN giving the Utes a 73.5% shot. Utah leads the Big 12 race and has the most to lose in a late-night road spot.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-arizona-kansas.blurb: No. 19 Arizona is a seven-point road favorite at Kansas State, with ESPN putting the Wildcats of Tucson at 74.5%. The total sits at 52.5.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-lsu-tennessee.blurb: Unranked LSU is a 1.5-point favorite at No. 9 Tennessee, and ESPN's model splits it almost exactly down the middle at 50.1%. With the total at 45.5, expect a tight, defense-tilted night in Knoxville.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-maryland-usc.blurb: No. 18 USC is a 17.5-point home favorite over Maryland and a 93.1% pick by ESPN. With a 57.5 total, the Trojans should have room to pile up points.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-wofford-ole-mi.blurb: No. 25 Ole Miss hosts FCS Wofford in a game ESPN's model pegs at 99.7% for the Rebels. No line posted, and no suspense expected.

predictions:ucla.blurb: UCLA holds steady at No. 4, but the models aren't fully on board — 12th in SP+ and 25th in FPI suggest the Bruins' ranking is running ahead of their profile.

games:2026-wk12-kentucky-missouri.blurb: No. 16 Kentucky heads to Columbia as a 5.5-point underdog, with ESPN giving Missouri a 61.5% shot at the upset of the ranked visitor. A total of 48.5 points to a grinding afternoon, and the Wildcats can't afford another slip.

games:2026-wk12-san-diego-state-boise-st.blurb: No. 17 Boise State lays 16.5 at home against San Diego State with a 61.5 total, and ESPN pegs the Broncos at nearly 94%. The newly ranked Broncos just need to keep the resume clean.

games:2026-wk12-texas-tech-baylor.blurb: No. 12 Texas Tech is a 3.5-point favorite at Baylor in the week's most dangerous Big 12 road trip, with ESPN giving the Red Raiders a 61.4% edge. Sitting on the playoff cut line, Tech can't let a 55.5-point shootout get away.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-byu-kansas.blurb: No. 10 BYU goes to Lawrence favored by 5.5 with a modest 47.5 total, and ESPN gives the Cougars a 71% shot. Still chasing Utah in the Big 12, BYU needs every win to stay in the automatic-bid conversation.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-iowa-illinois.blurb: No. 15 Iowa is an 8.5-point favorite at Illinois with the total down at 40.5 -- exactly the kind of low-scoring Big Ten game the Hawkeyes want. ESPN has Iowa at 65.3%, and a team on the outside of the field can't afford a stumble.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-oregon-michiga.blurb: No. 13 Oregon is a 16.5-point favorite in East Lansing with an 86.4% win probability from ESPN's model. The Ducks are knocking on the door of the playoff field and this is a game they're expected to put away.
